notes: Story 8706b4f7 is a downstream victim of the Ymir Link Cuenote FC breach already on file. Added Peach's 8,997,106-record figure to that event, attributed to Cybersecurity.com (Japan), with an evidence quote. Kept status, validation and severity as they were. validate.mjs leaves one earlier warning, figure-no-evidence for 47,864,147 in the title, which comes from Ymir Link's page and was not read in this run. A WebSearch summary also mentioned Peach's separate IDC Frontier ransomware incident of 7 October; it is older than the map window and was not in the assignment.
